citations.narrative:
During the inspection, 4 young Russian hamsters were observed to be out of their enclosure and running around on the
floor of the building. It is unclear how they escaped, but some of the enclosures have small circular openings on the side
where a nipple system can be attached to the enclosure which is open because water bottles on top of the cages are
being used instead. In addition, the licensee stated that sometimes the cage lids don't fit securely and leave a gap
between the lid and enclosure where a hamster could escape.
Hamsters that have escaped their enclosure could be at risk of injury or escape from the barn as well as the inability to
access food and water.
The licensee must ensure that the enclosure contains the animals at all times and does not allow them to escape.
Housing facilities must be adequate to protect the animals from injury and to contain the animals.
Correct by: September 17, 2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the licensee.
